title: User Guide
text: baseline_ functions get IDP data, least one following parameters must provided: operation, admin0_name, admin0_pcode. operation: Optional; Name DTM operation data collected. admin0_name: Optional; Name country data collected. admin0_pcode: Optional; Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3). admin1_name: Optional; Name level 1 administrative boundaries. admin1_pcode: Optional; Place code level 1 administrative boundaries. admin2_name: Optional; Name level 2 administrative boundaries. admin2_pcode: Optional; Place code level 2 administrative boundaries. from_reporting_date: Optional; Start date reporting period (format: ‘YYYY-MM-DD’). to_reporting_date: Optional; End date reporting period (format: ‘YYYY-MM-DD’). from_round_number: Optional; Starting round number data collection range. to_round_number: Optional; Ending round number data collection range.

title: User Guide
text: hna_get_admin2(), least one following parameters must provided: admin0_name admin0_pcode. admin0_name: Optional; Name country data collected. admin0_pcode: Optional; Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3). population_group: Optional; specific subpopulation (e.g. internally displaced persons). year: Optional; Year data collection. page: Optional; Pagination, fetch certain chunk data.
